title: Speculative enquiry - graduate / junior civil or project engineering (construction materials and project services)
content_text:
Careers - Wagners
Work Where You Matter
Wagners is a leading producer of construction materials and services for Australian and International markets. Founded in 1989 in Toowoomba, Queensland, we are an ASX-listed, innovative company known for quality, reliability and growth.
Multiple Locations: With over 22 locations across Australia and a growing international presence, we offer flexible, long-term career pathways across a variety of roles.
We invest in your growth and wellbeing. Through hands-on experience, formal training and annual apprenticeship intakes, we support learning at every stage of your career.
Build your future, make an impact and belong at Wagners.
You can get in contact with our People and Culture Team by emailing careers@wagner.com.au
Search & Apply For Roles is also offered on the careers page for current vacancies.
Business areas include Construction Materials, Cement, Concrete, Quarries, Steel Reinforcing, Engineering Solutions, Transport, Project Services (mobile crushing, mobile concrete, precast concrete, transport projects), and Composite Fibre Technologies.
This tick found no dated open graduate civil engineer vacancy on the careers page; this record is a speculative enquiry to the published People and Culture careers inbox.
apply_instructions: Email People and Culture at careers@wagner.com.au (published on https://www.wagner.com.au/careers/) with resume and cover letter; also monitor Search & Apply For Roles for dated vacancies.
